about_the_game:
Take control of the Chaos Lord's army and command a flying fortress, recruit and upgrade your units, and explore a fantasy world filled with challenges. The demo includes a selection of missions from the campaign, allowing you to experience the gameplay and mechanics of this exciting sequel.

Key features of the demo version:

  • Limited campaign missions to give you a taste of the story.

  • Access to select units and abilities to try out different tactics.

  • Explore the enhanced visuals and animations of the new game

Story

After the tragic death of King Aurelius, Archbishop Marius approaches the Elder Undead Lords with the desire to strike a deal with them. Succumbing to temptation, Marius plans to obtain an artifact capable of giving the Inquisition an unlimited power. In return, he will help the lords capture the coveted Temple of Water. The Undead Lords accept the deal and so the Lord of Chaos enters the game.

You'll be able to create a unique squad, by recruiting new warriors with a multitude of skills and weapon preferences. The tasks that will be assigned to you will require not only the strength of your warriors, but also cunning. The search for valuable artifacts, raiding cities, subduing enemy commanders, desecrating lands, and capturing altars are only a few of the challenges you will face.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or OpenGL 3.3 compatible video card
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i3 or higher
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or OpenGL 3.3 compatible video card
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

short_description: Welcome to the demo version of Stones Keeper II: Chaos Lord! This version gives you a sneak peek into the tactical RPG and turn-based strategy gameplay of the full game.
supported_languages: English, Russian, Portuguese - Brazil, Turkish, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Polish
